cardpage.aviso.AMOSTRA_PEQUENA_NA_JANELA: Few tasks in the window ({n} of at least {minimo}): the numbers are unstable.
card.fx01.oQueMostra: Per week, how many tasks came in, started and left, with cancelled ones apart. Each bar opens that week's tasks for that series.
card.fx01.comoCalcula: Weeks run Monday to Sunday in Manaus time, the last 12 (today's week is incomplete). Came in = creation date; started = first entry into an active, waiting or blocked status; left = positive completion (done category and a non-cancelling resolution) by resolution date. Only the tasks you can see.
card.fx02.oQueMostra: The totals for the last 12 weeks (came in, started, left and cancelled) and the growing-backlog signal.
card.fx02.comoCalcula: Balance = came in minus left minus cancelled. Growing backlog = intake exceeded output in 3 or more consecutive CLOSED weeks, up to the last one (the current week does not count).
fluxo.pergunta: Is the backlog growing or shrinking? How many tasks come in, start and leave each week.
fluxo.nota: Weeks run Monday to Sunday (Manaus). The current week is incomplete and does not count towards the growing-backlog signal.
card.aw01.oQueMostra: For each flow stage, the in-progress tasks as dots with their age in the stage, against the normal band (P50 and P85) of that same stage. Each stage and each "above normal" count opens its tasks.
card.aw01.comoCalcula: Age = time since the last entry into the current status, in business days (or calendar days). Band = P50 and P85 of the time that tasks completed in the last 16 weeks spent in that status; a stage with fewer than 5 completed tasks has no band. Waiting and blocked are stages of their own; the order comes from the status_map.
card.aw02.oQueMostra: How many tasks are in progress and how many of them have been in their stage longer than that stage's historical P85.
card.aw02.comoCalcula: In progress = active, waiting or blocked, open, within your scope. Above normal = age in the stage greater than the stage's P85; with no band (fewer than 5 completed tasks) nobody counts.
aging.pergunta: Where have tasks been sitting in a stage longer than normal, before they turn into delays?
aging.legenda.faixa: Normal band of the stage (P50 to P85)
aging.nota: Age = time since the last entry into the stage. A stage with fewer than 5 completed tasks in its history has no band, and nobody counts as above normal in it. The dot shows no person.
aging.vazio: No in-progress stage in this selection.
cardpage.aviso.SEM_VINCULOS_NA_BASE: No {tipo} links in the base: blockers show up once the synchronization brings the links.
cardpage.aviso.BLOQUEIO_FORA_DA_BASE: {n} task(s) have a blocker outside the base (another project or outside the card spec): check in Jira.
card.bq01.oQueMostra: Open tasks that depend on another task that is still open, with the blocker and its due date.
card.bq01.comoCalcula: Link of the type configured in vinculos.yaml (the one that "blocks" is the blocker), no removed link and no completed blocker. The Task × Review pair is left out (handled in Divergence). Only the tasks you can see.
card.bq02.oQueMostra: The open tasks that hold others up and are within your reach. Those of people you cannot see are counted apart, with no key or name.
card.bq02.comoCalcula: Distinct blockers (the same task is not repeated) of the blocked tasks. There is no ranking: nothing counts how many tasks each one holds up.
card.bq03.oQueMostra: Tasks blocked by a task that is due AFTER them: one due date does not fit the other.
card.bq03.comoCalcula: Blocker due date later than the blocked task's, both filled in. A blocker with no due date is not a conflict: it shows with the "no due date" notice.
card.bq04.oQueMostra: Tasks in a blocked status or with the impediment flag but with no open blocker in Jira: the reason for the block is not recorded.
card.bq04.comoCalcula: Blocked category (or impediment flag) and no open link that blocks it, nor an end outside the base. This is the BLOQUEADA_SEM_CAUSA data quality check.
card.bq05.oQueMostra: Tasks whose blocking link points to a task that is not in the base: from here there is no way to know whether the blocker is still open.
card.bq05.comoCalcula: Link of the configured type whose other end does not exist in the base (another project or outside the card spec). It does not count as a block until checked.
bloqueios.pergunta: Which tasks are held up by another task that is still open, and does one due date fit the other?
bloqueios.foraDaVisao: {n} from another squad (no key or name)
bloqueios.semCausaTexto: {n} with no link to explain it
bloqueios.nota: Order: by the blocked task's due date (never by person). No ranking of blockers. A blocker owned by someone outside your view shows as "task from another squad", with no key or name.
bloqueios.vazio: No task blocked by another open task in this selection.
bloqueios.foraDaBaseSemChave: task outside the base (check in Jira)
card.ct01.oQueMostra: Each completed task as a dot (completion day x days of cycle), by type, with the moving average and the P50 and P85 bands. It shows whether the process is stable and which tasks fall off the curve. Each dot opens that day's tasks of that type.
card.ct01.comoCalcula: Cycle = from the first entry into an active status to the resolution, in business days (or calendar days), positive completions only; completion day in Manaus time. Moving average: 20% of the points, an odd number, at least 5. Checklist and Review are not mixed. Option to drop cycles over 30 calendar days.
card.ct02.oQueMostra: P50 and P85 of the cycle month by month, per type, to see whether the process is getting faster. Each month opens that month's completed tasks of that type.
card.ct02.comoCalcula: The same cycles as in Cycle control, grouped by the (Manaus) month of completion. A month with fewer than 5 tasks shows the number with a small-sample warning.
controle.erro: Could not load the cycle control.
controle.vazio: No completed task with a cycle in this period.
controle.indisponivel: Unavailable while there is an incomplete-data warning.
controle.nota: Each dot is a completed task (completion day in Manaus time x days of cycle). Checklist and Review are not mixed, and the dot shows no person.
controle.excluidos: {n} cycle(s) over {dias} calendar days were dropped.
controle.legenda.faixa: P50 and P85 of the type
card.cz01.oQueMostra: Cross-table of the open tasks by two axes of your choice (type, status, squad, age band...), with the count or the P50 age in each cell. Each cell and each total opens its tasks.
card.cz01.comoCalcula: Open tasks in your scope, grouped by the two axes of the closed list. P50 age = median age (since the first entry into in-progress) in the filter's unit; a cell with fewer than 5 tasks carries a small-sample warning. Person only as rows, in alphabetical order, with no per-person total; the order is never by count.
cruzamentos.pergunta: How do the open tasks spread across two axes of your choice, without asking for a new screen?
cruzamentos.nota: The values of each axis follow the axis' own order, never by count. Person only as rows, in alphabetical order and with no per-person total. The axes and the measure live in the URL.
cruzamentos.unidadeNota: Age in {unidade}, since the first entry into in-progress (or creation).
cruzamentos.vazio: No open task in this selection.
cruzamentos.legendaFaixa: Hatched = highest band (75% or more of the table's largest value). ● = P50 age of a cell with fewer than 5 tasks.

card.ts01.oQueMostra: How many tasks completed in the period go into this screen's calculations.
card.ts01.comoCalcula: Counts the tasks with a done status and a resolution, resolved in the period, with consistent dates and within your view. The types and statuses that the card sheet excludes are left out.
card.ts02.oQueMostra: What share of the analyzed tasks' time was spent in active statuses.
card.ts02.comoCalcula: Time in active statuses ÷ total time outside done, summed over the analyzed tasks. Opening the card shows the analyzed tasks, which make up the numerator and the denominator.
card.ts03.oQueMostra: Open tasks stuck in their current status beyond what is normal for that status.
card.ts03.comoCalcula: Open for more than 1.5 × the status median (at least 2 days, in the chosen unit); the median comes from the tasks completed in the period.
card.ts04.oQueMostra: Median and P85 of the time completed tasks spent in each status.
card.ts04.comoCalcula: For each status, sums the stays per task (re-entries add up) and computes the median and P85 across the analyzed tasks; n is the number of tasks that went through the status.
card.ts05.oQueMostra: The relative weight of each status in the tasks' time, to find where they wait.
card.ts05.comoCalcula: Bar proportional to each status median, compared with the largest P85; same base and same n as the Time per status card.
card.ts06.oQueMostra: Median days of each person in each status, in alphabetical order and with no ranking.
card.ts06.comoCalcula: For each person and status, the median time the person was the assignee, across the analyzed tasks; n is the number of tasks. Bands: up to 3 days, 3 to 6 days, over 6 days.
card.ts07.oQueMostra: List of the open tasks stuck beyond normal.
card.ts07.comoCalcula: Same rule as the Stuck beyond normal card: time in the current status compared with the status median. The screen lists up to 50; the number counts all of them.
card.sy01.oQueMostra: Whether the panel is syncing with Jira or is switched off by the flag.
card.sy01.comoCalcula: Read from the configuration: periodic when the Jira flag is on, off when it is not. Only the user turns the flag on.
card.sy02.oQueMostra: The latest synchronizer runs for each instance, with counts and result.
card.sy02.comoCalcula: Read from the local database run log (up to 10 per instance): type, status, start, end, issues, events, requests and error code.
card.sy03.oQueMostra: The last local cleanup of old data.
card.au01.oQueMostra: How many changes to due dates, assignees and delay labels deserve a check in the period. Evidence, not proof.
card.au01.comoCalcula: Each change in the issue history (changelog) is compared with who could make it on the Manaus calendar date: the Reporter, coordination, the manager or the assignee's Squad Leader, with the roles in force that day. Counts the period's signals after the filters; opening the card lists the tasks behind it.
card.au02.oQueMostra: The count of signals of each type (due date, assignee change, ball-passing, delay labels, cancellation), in catalog order. There is no count per person.
card.au02.comoCalcula: Same universe as the Signals to review card, split by signal type. Limits and severities (days, swaps) come from the auditoria.yaml file.
card.au03.titulo: On time and adjusted on time
card.au03.oQueMostra: Of the completed tasks due in the period, how many were done by the due date (on time) and how many also counting those with a label that justifies the delay (adjusted on time).
card.au03.comoCalcula: Completed = done category and a filled-in resolution. On time: resolution day (Manaus time zone) up to the due date. Adjusted: on time or with a justified delay label (labels_atraso.yaml). A label under audit still counts and shows in the separate counter.
card.dv01.oQueMostra: Task and Review pairs with different due dates.
card.dv01.comoCalcula: Pair = task and Review linked by the issue link Blocks / is blocked by, in both directions (the parent field does not count). Mismatch: different due dates, or only one of them filled in. Percentage = mismatched ÷ pairs.
card.sy03.comoCalcula: Read from the retention run log. The cleanup only deletes local data and never talks to Jira.

auditoria.kpi.noPrazo.dica: {n} of {total} completed by the due date
auditoria.kpi.noPrazoAjustado.dica: {n} of {total}, counting those with a label that justifies the delay
auditoria.kpi.justificadas.dica: Late tasks adjusted by a label that also has a signal; they still count in the adjusted figure
auditoria.lista.limite: Showing {n} of {total} signals. Use the drawer or the CSV to see them all.
auditoria.emLote.dica: Same person, same field and same minute on {n} issues or more: context, not proof.
auditoria.semPermissao: Only coordination and the manager can see the audit. Ask the coordinator for access if you need it.
auditoria.filtroInvalido: A filter is invalid. Check the dates (From cannot be after To; 180 days at most) and the fields, and apply again.
auditoria.erro: The audit could not be loaded.
auditoria.aviso.REPORTER_ALTERADO: {n} issue(s) with a reporter change in the history: authorization uses the current reporter and may have been checked against the wrong PL.
auditoria.aviso.VENCIMENTO_ILEGIVEL: {n} unreadable due date value(s) in the history were ignored in the comparisons.
auditoria.aviso.ISSUES_IGNORADAS_STATUS: {n} issue(s) with unmapped status "{status}" were left out (see Data quality).
auditoria.aviso.VINCULO_AMBIGUO: {n} ambiguous Task × Review link(s): the pair with the lowest key was kept.

auditoria.aviso.HISTORICO_DE_WORKLOG_INC: {n} time log(s) still without a creation date: the next Jira load fills them and only then do they enter the check.

cardpage.aviso.CAMPOS_DE_TRABALHO_INDISP: Priority and estimates have not been synchronized yet: those numbers show empty until the next synchronization.

card.ab01.oQueMostra: How many tasks are open right now and, of those, how many are in progress.
card.ab01.comoCalcula: Open = no resolution date and outside the done category (Cancelled, Canceled and Dropped are left out). In progress = active, waiting or blocked status, or with the impediment flag. Follows the view of your role.
card.ab02.titulo: Historical age by type (P50 and P85)
card.ab02.oQueMostra: How long the tasks of each type took, from the start of work to completion, over the last 16 weeks: the reference for deciding whether an open task is old.
card.ab02.comoCalcula: Cycle of the completed tasks (done category, a resolution that is not a cancellation, and a resolution date) from the last 16 weeks, in business or calendar days. P50 and P85 per type, using only the tasks in your view; with fewer than 5 tasks the number shows with a small-sample warning.
card.ab04.oQueMostra: In-progress tasks older than 85% of the completed tasks of the same type: candidates for attention.
card.ab04.comoCalcula: Age (from the start of work until now) greater than the P85 of the historical cycle of its OWN type. In-progress tasks only; a type with no completed history is not counted (there is a warning). Same time unit as the screen.
card.ab05.oQueMostra: How many open tasks are in each status, in flow order.
card.ab05.comoCalcula: Count of open tasks by current status. The order comes from status_map.yaml (ordem); statuses outside the order go last.
card.ab06.oQueMostra: How many open tasks there are for each Jira priority.
card.ab06.comoCalcula: Count of open tasks by the synchronized priority. While no task has a synchronized priority the card stays empty with a warning, and never shows everything as unprioritized.
card.ab07.oQueMostra: How many open tasks are in each age band: up to 7, 8 to 14, 15 to 30 and more than 30 days.
card.ab07.comoCalcula: Age = from the start of work (or from creation, if it never started) until now, in the chosen unit (business or calendar days).
card.ab08.oQueMostra: How many open tasks are already overdue, due within 7 days, due later or have no due date.
card.ab08.comoCalcula: Due date compared with today in Manaus: overdue = before today; within 7 days = from today to today + 7; later = beyond that; none = no due date.
card.ab09.oQueMostra: All the open tasks in your view, with status, priority, age, due date and remaining hours; sortable and exportable.
card.ab09.comoCalcula: Same universe as the Open card. Remaining hours come from the Jira remaining estimate and stay empty when the task has none.
card.ng01.oQueMostra: In-progress tasks that Jira has not updated for more than 7 days.
card.ng01.comoCalcula: In progress (active, waiting or blocked) and the update date (updated) more than 7 calendar days old. A comment also updates it, which is why each row shows the last real movement.
card.ng02.oQueMostra: Open tasks that nobody has taken.
card.ng02.comoCalcula: Open tasks with an empty assignee. Only coordination and managers see this queue.
card.ng03.oQueMostra: Open tasks whose due date has passed.
card.ng03.comoCalcula: Due date before today (Manaus day), in any open status.
card.ng04.oQueMostra: Open tasks that are blocked or flagged with an impediment.
card.ng04.comoCalcula: Blocked category in the status map, or the impediment flag turned on in Jira.
card.ng05.oQueMostra: In-progress tasks that have been in the same status for too long.
card.ng05.comoCalcula: In progress only. Time in the current status greater than the larger of 3 days and 2 times the median of that status among the tasks completed in the last 16 weeks (only 3 days when there is no median). It is a separate list from No update.
card.ng06.titulo: To do for more than 30 days
card.ng06.oQueMostra: Tasks that have been waiting in the queue for more than 30 days.
card.ng06.comoCalcula: To-do category for more than 30 calendar days in the current status (or since creation, if it never changed status).
card.fe01.oQueMostra: How many tasks were completed in the period.
card.fe01.comoCalcula: Completed = done category, a resolution that is not a cancellation, and a resolution date. The day is the Manaus day of the resolution. Follows the view of your role.
card.fe02.oQueMostra: Sum of the points of the tasks completed in the period; opens the completed tasks that have points.
card.fe02.comoCalcula: Sum of the Story Points field of the completed tasks. A task without points adds nothing and does not count as zero; with no synchronized points the value stays empty.
card.fe03.oQueMostra: How long the completed tasks took from the start of work to the resolution.
card.fe03.comoCalcula: From the first entry into in-progress, waiting or blocked until the resolution, in business or calendar days. P50 and P85 by linear interpolation. Opens the completed tasks that enter the calculation.
card.fe04.oQueMostra: How long the completed tasks took from creation to the resolution.
card.fe04.comoCalcula: From creation to the resolution, in business or calendar days. P50 and P85 by linear interpolation.
card.fe05.titulo: On time and adjusted on time
card.fe05.oQueMostra: Of the completed tasks due in the period, how many were done by the due date and how many were done by the due date also counting those with a label that justifies the delay.
card.fe05.comoCalcula: Same rule as Audit and Goals: positive completion, not an Epic, due in the period. On time = Manaus day of the resolution up to the due date. Adjusted = on time or with a label from labels_atraso.yaml.
card.fe06.oQueMostra: Tasks closed with a cancellation resolution in the period and tasks in a done status without a resolution.
card.fe06.comoCalcula: Cancelled: done category with a cancellation resolution (status_map.yaml). Without resolution: entered a done status in the period without a resolution; goes to Data quality and does not count as a delivery.
card.fe07.oQueMostra: How many tasks were completed in each week (Monday to Sunday, Manaus time).
card.fe07.comoCalcula: Completed tasks grouped by the Monday of the week of the Manaus day of the resolution. A resolution on Sunday at 11:30 pm in Manaus falls in the week that ends on that Sunday.
card.fe08.oQueMostra: Each completed task as a point (resolution day and cycle days), with P50, P85 and P95.
card.fe08.comoCalcula: Cycle of each completed task, in the chosen unit. Percentiles use linear interpolation over all completed tasks that have a cycle.
card.fe09.oQueMostra: P50 and P85 of the cycle of each task type; types are never mixed.
card.fe09.comoCalcula: Percentiles of the cycle of the completed tasks of each type. With fewer than 5 tasks the number shows with a small-sample warning.
card.fe10.oQueMostra: How many completed tasks there are per project (key prefix).
card.fe10.comoCalcula: Completed tasks of the period grouped by the project of the task key (for example, TG).
card.fe11.oQueMostra: How many tasks each person finished and how many they took part in, with points, cycle and estimated and logged hours. No ranking: alphabetical order.
card.fe11.comoCalcula: Finished = was the assignee at the resolution. Took part = had the task at some point. Hours come from the estimate and time-spent fields of the task itself (per-person worklog is left for a future phase). Only people in your view.
card.fe12.oQueMostra: All the completed tasks of the period with cycle, lead, due date, deadline status and hours; sortable and exportable.
card.fe12.comoCalcula: Same universe as the Completed card. Deadline status: on time, adjusted (delay label), late or no due date. The table shows up to 500 rows; the count and the drawer bring all of them.
card.mt01.titulo: On time and adjusted on time
card.mt01.oQueMostra: Of the completed tasks due in the period, how many were done by the due date (on time) and how many also counting those with a label that justifies the delay (adjusted on time), side by side.
card.mt01.comoCalcula: Universe = completed tasks (done category, a resolution that is not a cancellation, a resolution date), not an Epic, due in the period. On time = Manaus day of the resolution up to the due date. Adjusted = on time or with a label from labels_atraso.yaml. Same rule as Audit and Completed.
card.mt02.titulo: On time by the original date
card.mt02.oQueMostra: How many tasks were done by the FIRST agreed due date, before deadlines were rescheduled.
card.mt02.comoCalcula: The original due date is the previous value of the first due-date change in the changelog (or the current one, if it never changed). The screen warns when the original rate is 5 percentage points or more below the rate by the current date (limit in metas.yaml).
card.mt03.oQueMostra: Tasks completed at least 1 day before the due date.
card.mt03.comoCalcula: Manaus day of the resolution minus the due date less than or equal to −1. The early target comes from metas.yaml.
card.mt04.oQueMostra: Tasks completed 1 or 2 days before the due date.
card.mt04.comoCalcula: Manaus day of the resolution minus the due date equal to −1 or −2.
card.mt05.oQueMostra: Tasks completed exactly on the due date.
card.mt05.comoCalcula: Manaus day of the resolution equal to the due date. A resolution at 11:30 pm in Manaus counts on that day, even though it is already the next day in UTC.
card.mt06.oQueMostra: Tasks completed after the due date.
card.mt06.comoCalcula: Manaus day of the resolution greater than the due date. Those with a label that justifies the delay stay here and also count as adjusted on time.
card.mt07.oQueMostra: Tasks completed in the period that have no due date and therefore stay out of the deadline rates.
card.mt07.comoCalcula: Positively completed tasks resolved in the period (Manaus day), not an Epic, with no due date.
card.mt08.oQueMostra: How many tasks of the universe are due in each period (day, week or month), split into on the day, early and late.
card.mt08.comoCalcula: The universe grouped by the period of the DUE DATE. Week = Monday to Sunday in Manaus; month = calendar month. Only periods with tasks appear.
card.mt09.oQueMostra: The on-time rate in each period, compared with the target.
card.mt09.comoCalcula: On time divided by the universe of each due-date period. The target line comes from metas.yaml. Each point opens the tasks that were on time in that period.
card.mt10.oQueMostra: How many tasks were done in each band relative to the due date: 3 or more days early, 2 days early, 1 day early, on the day, 1 to 3 days late and more than 3 days late.
card.mt10.comoCalcula: Bands of the difference between the Manaus day of the resolution and the due date: ≤ −3, −2, −1, 0, 1 to 3 and > 3.
card.mt11.oQueMostra: Universe, on time and adjusted on time for each task type, with the state against the target.
card.mt11.comoCalcula: Same universe as the On time card, by task type (alphabetical order). State: ✓ at or above the target, ● up to 10 percentage points below, ▲ further below (metas.yaml).
card.mt12.oQueMostra: Universe, on time and adjusted on time for each priority, with the state against the target.
card.mt12.comoCalcula: Same universe as the On time card, by synchronized priority (priority order; unprioritized last). Same state as the other tables.
card.mt13.oQueMostra: Universe, on time and adjusted on time for each squad, with the state against the target.
card.mt13.comoCalcula: The squad is the assignee's squad on the resolution day, from the role directory. Alphabetical order, never by rate.
card.mt14.oQueMostra: Universe, on time and adjusted on time for each person in your view, with the state against the target. No ranking: alphabetical order.
card.mt14.comoCalcula: The person is the assignee on the resolution day. Only people in your view; alphabetical order, with no position and no comparison between people.

abertas.tabela.vazia: No open tasks in your view.
abertas.prioridade.indisponivel: Priority not synchronized yet: no numbers here until the next synchronization.

negligenciadas.dica.aFazer: In the queue for more than 30 days

metas.tabela.vazia: No tasks in the universe for this table.

card.ne01.oQueMostra: Tasks that went back from done to not done in the period.
card.ne01.comoCalcula: A status transition from the done category to another category, by the event date in the changelog (not the task's update date). Each task counts once.
card.ne02.oQueMostra: Tasks that went back to an earlier stage of the flow in the period.
card.ne02.comoCalcula: A transition to a status with a lower position in the flow order (status_map.yaml), by the event date in the changelog. Reopening (done to not done) counts only in Reopened. Without a configured order the number is 0, with a warning.
card.ne03.oQueMostra: Tasks closed in the period with a cancellation resolution (Won't Do, Duplicate...).
card.ne03.comoCalcula: Done category with a cancellation resolution (status_map.yaml) and a resolution date in the period, in Manaus days.
card.ne04.oQueMostra: Tasks completed in the period after the due date, and how many of them have no label that justifies the delay.
card.ne04.comoCalcula: Positive completion resolved in the period, with a due date, whose Manaus resolution day is past the due date. Unjustified = no label from labels_atraso.yaml. The calculation is the same as Audit, Completed and Goals.
card.ne05.oQueMostra: Tasks still open whose due date has already passed.
card.ne05.comoCalcula: No resolution date, outside the done category, with a due date before today (Manaus day). It is today's snapshot and does not depend on the period.
card.ne06.oQueMostra: Tasks completed in the period whose time spent went over the original estimate by more than 25%.
card.ne06.comoCalcula: Time spent greater than 1.25 times the original estimate (both from the issue itself), only with an estimate above zero. Per-person worklog comes in Phase 6.
card.ne07.oQueMostra: Tasks that changed assignee 3 times or more in the period.
card.ne07.comoCalcula: Count of changes to the assignee field in the changelog dated in the period; the limit is 3 changes.
card.ne08.oQueMostra: What fraction of the period's completed tasks was reopened, sent back, delivered late and delivered late without justification. Above 20% the screen shows ▲.
card.ne08.comoCalcula: Each rate = numerator tasks (the same lists as the count cards) divided by the period's positive completions. With no completions the rate shows a dash. The card opens the numerator tasks.
card.ne10.oQueMostra: Reopened, sent back and late deliveries of each person in your scope. No ranking: alphabetical order.
card.ne10.comoCalcula: Each event goes to whoever was the assignee at the instant of the event (or of the resolution, for lateness). Only people in your scope; no position or comparison between people.
card.ri01.oQueMostra: How many open tasks are at high risk and at medium risk.
card.ri01.comoCalcula: A score from 0 to 100 adding points from factors (age above the P85 or median of its own type, stuck, overdue, blocked, reopened, reassignments, hours overrun, no update, no estimate). High from 60 points and medium from 30 (weights in risco.yaml, versioned).
card.ri02.oQueMostra: The list of tasks at high or medium risk, with the main factor and the points of each factor. The low level stays in the detail view for checking.
card.ri02.comoCalcula: Same score as the high and medium risk card; the list shows tasks with points equal to or above the medium limit. Each task's total is capped at 100 points.
card.ri03.oQueMostra: How many tasks at risk and how many open tasks each person in your scope has, as a proportion. No ranking: alphabetical order.
card.ri03.comoCalcula: By the open task's current assignee. It is a proportion of signals, not an assessment of the person; only people in your scope and no position or comparison.
card.pv01.oQueMostra: How many open tasks are still left to deliver in your scope.
card.pv01.comoCalcula: Tasks with no resolution date and outside the done category, only the ones you can see. It is the basis of the forecast.
card.pv02.oQueMostra: In how many weeks the backlog finishes, in P50, P85 and P95, with the date of the target week. The card opens the backlog tasks (the numerator of the forecast).
card.pv02.comoCalcula: Monte Carlo: draws the throughput and the arrival rate of each of the last closed weeks until the backlog reaches zero (10,000 draws, seed of the day and filters). Above 104 weeks the answer is "more than 104 weeks".
card.pv03.oQueMostra: How much history supports the forecast: low, medium or high, by weeks with data. The card opens the deliveries of the window.
card.pv03.comoCalcula: Low with fewer than 8 weeks with data, medium until 16 are complete and high with 16. Weeks with data = from the first week with activity to the last closed week.
card.pv04.oQueMostra: How many tasks were delivered and how many were created in each closed week (Monday to Sunday, Manaus).
card.pv04.comoCalcula: Deliveries: positive completions by resolution date; arrivals: tasks created in the week. Cancelled tasks are left out of deliveries. The same series feeds the Monte Carlo.
card.pv05.titulo: How many items in 2, 4 and 8 weeks
card.pv05.oQueMostra: How many tasks should come out in 2, 4 and 8 weeks, in conservative P50, P85 and P95. It is a projection, with no tasks behind it.
card.pv05.comoCalcula: Sum of throughputs drawn from the history. P85 is the 15th percentile of the totals and P95 the 5th (85% and 95% of the draws did at least that).
card.pv06.oQueMostra: For each in-progress task, how much is left according to the history of cycles of the same type that went past its age.
card.pv06.comoCalcula: Of the completed cycles of the same type longer than the task's age, what was left (P50 and P85). With fewer than 5 longer cycles, a dash. "By capacity" is the finish forecast from the assignee's capacity queue (absences and holidays included) and "Late?" compares it with the due date.
card.ep01.oQueMostra: Per epic: tasks, completed, progress, the oldest open one, overdue, points and forecast in weeks.
card.ep01.comoCalcula: Items = tasks with the epic, without review types and without cancelled ones. Progress = completed ÷ items. The forecast (P85) uses only the epic's own throughput and only with 5 or more of its deliveries in the history; without its own sample it is a dash.
card.cp01.oQueMostra: How similar the occupancy of the people in your view is: 1.0 = all equal. It is an index of the group, never a score for a person.
card.cp01.comoCalcula: Jain index over the 4-week occupancy (demand ÷ capacity) of those with capacity, each value capped at the planning ceiling. No value with fewer than 2 people. There are no tasks behind it.
card.cp02.oQueMostra: How many people are above capacity and how many have slack. The card opens the tasks in the queue of those people.
card.cp02.comoCalcula: 4-week occupancy above the high limit (110%) counts as above capacity; below the slack limit (50%) counts as with slack. Limits in planejamento.yaml. No ranking: counts only.
card.cp03.oQueMostra: For each person, in alphabetical order: open, in progress, queue in hours, 4-week capacity, occupancy, absence, overdue, above P85 and high risk.
card.cp03.comoCalcula: Queue = remaining hours (Jira remaining; otherwise estimate minus logged; otherwise default hours by type, assumed). Occupancy = demand ÷ capacity; zero capacity is "no capacity". An overdue task becomes accumulated delay.
card.ca01.oQueMostra: How many alerts of weeks with load above the limit or with absence and scheduled work.
card.ca01.comoCalcula: High load: weekly occupancy above the high limit. Absence with work: a week with 2 or more absence days and hours scheduled on those days in the no-absence scenario. There are no tasks behind it.
card.ca02.oQueMostra: How many tasks are expected to finish after the due date, given the person's capacity.
card.ca02.comoCalcula: The person's queue consumes the net capacity day by day (order: started, priority, due date). It is late when the forecast finish is after the due date. Tasks already overdue are left out.
card.ca03.oQueMostra: How many of the forecast delays would not exist if the person had no absence.
card.ca03.comoCalcula: Compares the forecast with the absence against the forecast with capacity without absence; counts the tasks that are late only in the first scenario.
card.ca04.oQueMostra: How similar the occupancy of the people in your view is: 1.0 = all equal. It is an index of the group, never a score for a person.
card.ca04.comoCalcula: Jain index over the 4-week occupancy of those with capacity, each value capped at the planning ceiling. No value with fewer than 2 people. There are no tasks behind it.
card.ca05.oQueMostra: Each person's occupancy over 8 weeks; "abs." when absence removes all the capacity of the week.
card.ca05.comoCalcula: Week demand ÷ net capacity; the current week counts from today to Sunday. Zero capacity is "no capacity", never a percentage. People in alphabetical order.
card.ca06.oQueMostra: Each high-load alert or absence-with-scheduled-work alert, with the hours to reschedule.
card.ca06.comoCalcula: The same rules as the alerts card, one row per person and week. Hours to reschedule are those scheduled on absence days in the no-absence scenario.
card.ca07.oQueMostra: Who is absent in the next 8 weeks. The panel neither stores nor shows the reason.
card.ca07.comoCalcula: Read from ausencias.yaml (read-only), only for the people in your view and in alphabetical order.
card.ca08.oQueMostra: The holidays in the next 8 weeks, which count as zero capacity.
card.ca08.comoCalcula: Read from calendario.yaml. A holiday on a weekend is not deducted twice.
card.ca09.oQueMostra: Each task expected to be late, with due date, forecast finish and the cause (absence or load).
card.ca09.comoCalcula: The same calculation as Forecast delays; the cause is absence when the delay disappears in the no-absence scenario.
card.cl01.oQueMostra: Holidays, absences and due dates of each day, with the team capacity of the day. Each day opens the tasks due on it.
card.cl01.comoCalcula: Team capacity = net ÷ gross capacity of the people you see (empty on a non-working day). Critical day = working day with due dates and capacity below the planning limit. Absence has no reason.
card.pl01.oQueMostra: Planned hours against each person's capacity in each week. Each cell opens the tasks that fill the week.
card.pl01.comoCalcula: Each task's hours are spread from the current week to the due week (minimum weeks in planejamento.yaml); without a due date, 2 weeks if started and 4 if not. The current week counts from today to Sunday. Zero capacity is "no capacity".
card.ve01.oQueMostra: How many open tasks are due in the next 7 or 14 days, with the forecast finish and the real slack of each.
card.ve01.comoCalcula: Finish forecast by the assignee's capacity (queue with absences and holidays). Slack = working days between the finish and the due date. Tasks already overdue are left out.
card.ve02.oQueMostra: How many of those due in the coming days are expected to finish after the due date or have no finish forecast.
card.ve02.comoCalcula: Negative real slack (the forecast finish is after the due date), or no forecast finish (does not fit in the horizon or no assignee).
card.ga01.oQueMostra: How many tasks were in each status at the end of each of the last 60 days, in flow order.
card.ga01.comoCalcula: Rebuilt from the changelog (the status at the end of each Manaus day). The done status is left out. There are no tasks behind it: it is a series.
card.ga02.oQueMostra: How many tasks are in each stage today and where there is a bottleneck. The card opens the tasks of the stage.
card.ga02.comoCalcula: Bottleneck = active or waiting stage with more tasks than the WIP limit in planejamento.yaml, or whose band grew at least max(3, 30%) in 15 days. A "to do" stage is never a bottleneck.
card.ga03.oQueMostra: How many people are above capacity in the next 4 weeks. The card opens the tasks in their queue.
card.ga03.comoCalcula: 4-week occupancy (demand ÷ net capacity) above the planning high limit. No ranking: only the count.
card.ga04.oQueMostra: How many people have slack in the next 4 weeks. The card opens the tasks in their queue.
card.ga04.comoCalcula: 4-week occupancy below the planning slack limit (50%). No ranking: only the count.
card.td01.oQueMostra: Each person's occupancy over the last 12 weeks and whether overload is recurring or one-off.
card.td01.comoCalcula: Rebuilt from the changelog (assignee and due date of each Monday) with TODAY's hours, because there is no stored weekly snapshot. Recurring = 3 or more of the last 4 weeks above the high limit; one-off = 1 or 2.
card.ps01.oQueMostra: The tasks of the period (resolved in it, plus the open ones) with how long each person held them and how many times the assignee changed. The card opens the tasks.
card.ps01.comoCalcula: Time of each stretch with the same assignee, outside the done statuses, in business (or calendar) days up to the resolution or now; the share is the person's time ÷ the task's total time. Anyone outside your view shows as "another person", never by name.
card.ps02.oQueMostra: In how many tasks each person in your view held ownership and for how long. No ranking: people in alphabetical order. The card opens the person's tasks.
card.ps02.comoCalcula: Sum of the person's ownership time over the tasks of the period. Received and handed over = assignee changes the person took part in (from or to someone else).
card.ef01.oQueMostra: The effort of each task completed in the period, in three components side by side (type weight, tests and hours) and the composite index. The card opens the tasks.
card.ef01.comoCalcula: Index = type weight + tests × test weight + hours × hour factor (initial proposal in esforco.yaml, to be calibrated with real data). Tests = distinct TEST-* labels; hours = sum of the worklog (without a worklog, Jira's time spent, with a warning). Only positive completions.
card.ef02.oQueMostra: The effort of completed tasks split among the people in your view by ownership (the share of time with the task), not by the worklog author. No ranking. The card opens the person's tasks.
card.ef02.comoCalcula: For each task, each effort component × the person's ownership share; summed per person, in alphabetical order.
card.cb01.oQueMostra: Upcoming absences of people in your view and the work left uncovered: affected tasks, hours to replan, skills requested and who can cover. The card opens the affected tasks.
card.cb01.comoCalcula: Affected task = the person's open task that the schedule (without the absence) would place on those days, plus those due during it that would not finish before. Hours = hours scheduled on those days. Candidates = people of the same squad with slack (capacity − demand) in the absence weeks, in alphabetical order, not sorted by slack.
card.si01.oQueMostra: What would slip if a person were away for a period: the tasks that become late and the hours to replan, with occupancy before and after. Nothing is saved. The card opens the tasks that become late.
card.si01.comoCalcula: Compares the capacity-based schedule with and without the hypothetical absence (fraction 0.5 or 1.0, at most 60 days). Delay caused = the task was not late and becomes late. Read-only: no absence is registered.
card.cm01.oQueMostra: Who has each skill in your view and which skills depend on a single person.
card.cm01.comoCalcula: Skills from equipes.yaml for the people in your view. Single person = a skill with exactly one visible person (only shown with 2 or more people in view).
card.cm02.oQueMostra: Open tasks that ask for a skill (label skill:x) that nobody in your view has. The card opens the tasks.
card.cm02.comoCalcula: Label skill:x of the open task with no person in view having the skill in equipes.yaml.
card.cm03.oQueMostra: Open tasks and hours per requested skill. The card opens the skill's tasks.
card.cm03.comoCalcula: Open tasks in view with the skill:x label; hours from the planning rules (remaining, estimate or default per type).
card.rv01.oQueMostra: The open reviews of each reviewer in your view, how many are overdue and how many passed the review deadline. The card opens the tasks.
card.rv01.comoCalcula: Open tasks of the review types (auditoria.yaml) by assignee. Overdue = due date before today. Past deadline = age in business days since creation above the planning limit. Age P50 = median of the ages.
card.rv02.oQueMostra: Open reviews with no assignee (coordination and manager only). The card opens the tasks.
card.rv02.comoCalcula: Open tasks of the review types with no assignee, within the filters.
card.cg01.oQueMostra: Open tasks and queue hours by task type and OS version. The card opens the cell's tasks.
card.cg01.comoCalcula: Open tasks in view grouped by type × OS Version (no OS is its own row); hours from the planning rules.
card.cg02.oQueMostra: Tasks completed in the period and their effort by task type and OS version. The card opens the cell's tasks.
card.cg02.comoCalcula: Positive completions in the period (by resolution) grouped by type × OS Version; effort = sum of each task's composite index.
pessoas.horasAssumidas: Part of the hours is assumed by the rule per type (no remaining time or estimate in Jira)
cardpage.aviso.PESSOAS_SEM_CADASTRO_NA_E: {n} person(s) with open tasks are not in equipes.yaml: their capacity is not in the calculations.
cardpage.aviso.HORAS_ASSUMIDAS: Part of the hours was assumed by the rule per type, because the task has no remaining time or estimate in Jira: lower confidence.
cardpage.aviso.HORAS_ATUAIS_NO_PASSADO: Past weeks use today's hours: there is no stored weekly snapshot.
carga.pergunta: How much work does each person have queued, and how much fits in the capacity of the next 4 weeks?
carga.kpi.jain.nota: 1.00 = all equal; an index of the group, never a score for a person
carga.kpi.jain.indisponivel: Unavailable with fewer than 2 people with capacity
carga.vazia: No team member in your view.
carga.nota: ≈ = part of the hours assumed by the rule per type. Accumulated delay = hours of tasks already overdue, outside the occupancy. Logged hours depend on the worklog (not synced yet).
capacidade.pergunta: Where does capacity not cover the work, and which delays come from absences?
capacidade.mapa.legenda: Occupancy = week demand ÷ week capacity. "abs." = absence removes all the capacity of the week. Alphabetical order, no ranking.
capacidade.alerta.CARGA_ALTA: load above the limit in the week of {semana}
capacidade.alerta.AUSENCIA_COM_TRABALHO: absence with scheduled work in the week of {semana}: about {h} h to reschedule
capacidade.ausencias.vazia: No absence in the next 8 weeks.
capacidade.ausencias.nota: Read from ausencias.yaml (read-only). The panel neither stores nor shows the reason.
capacidade.feriados.vazio: No holiday in the next 8 weeks.
capacidade.atrasos.vazio: No task is expected to be late by capacity.
capacidade.semTermino: does not fit in the horizon
calendario.pergunta: Who is absent, when are the holidays and what is due each day?
calendario.nota: Critical day = working day with due dates and team capacity below the planning limit. Absence has no reason.
plano.pergunta: How many hours does each person have planned for the coming weeks, against capacity?
plano.legenda: The current week counts from today to Sunday. Hours = planned / capacity. Zero capacity is "no capacity", with the planned hours beside it.
plano.abreCelula: Tasks of {pessoa} in the week of {semana}: {n}
vencimentos.pergunta: What is due in the coming days and who is at risk of being late?
vencimentos.kpi.risco.dica: Forecast finish after the due date or no forecast
vencimentos.vazia: Nothing is due in the period.
vencimentos.nota: Slack = working days between the finish forecast by capacity and the due date. Tasks already overdue are left out (see overdue in Load).
gargalos.pergunta: Where does work pile up and who is above capacity?
gargalos.fluxo.nota: How many tasks were in each status at the end of each day, from {de} to {ate}. Today (and the change over 15 days) beside it.
gargalos.etapas.nota: Bottleneck = active or waiting stage above the WIP limit, or whose band grew at least max(3, 30%) in 15 days.
gargalos.tabela.titulo: 60-day cumulative flow: tasks per status and day
gargalos.tabela.regiao: Scrollable area of the cumulative flow table
gargalos.vazia: No tasks in progress in your view.
gargalos.motivo.FAIXA_CRESCEU: the band grew in the last 15 days
tendencia.pergunta: Is each person's overload recurring or was it one-off in the last 12 weeks?
tendencia.nota: Rebuilt from the changelog (assignee and due date of each Monday) with TODAY's hours: there is no stored weekly snapshot.
posse.pergunta: Who held each task and for how long, and how many times did the assignee change?
posse.nota: Each person answers for the time they held the task. Anyone outside your view (or with no assignee) shows as "another person", without a name.
esforco.pergunta: How much effort did each completed task cost, and how is it split among people by ownership?
esforco.linha: Type {tipo} · Tests TEST-* {testes} · Hours {horas} h · Index {indice}
esforco.horasDoCampo: hours from Jira's time spent (the task has no worklog)
esforco.vazia: No tasks completed in the period.
esforco.rodape: Rules: {versao} — initial proposal, to be calibrated with real data. People in alphabetical order, no ranking.
cardpage.aviso.HORAS_DO_CAMPO_TIMESPENT: In {n} task(s) without a worklog, the hours came from Jira's time spent.
cobertura.pergunta: What work is left without an owner in the coming absences and who in the squad can cover it?
cobertura.semTrabalho: No work to cover in this period.
cobertura.candidatos.nota: In alphabetical order, not sorted by slack.
cobertura.ninguem: Nobody in the squad has slack in those weeks.
cobertura.nota: Candidates are from the same squad and slack is capacity minus demand in the absence weeks.
simulador.pergunta: What would slip if a person were away for a period? Read-only simulation: nothing is saved.
simulador.tabela: Occupancy per week: before and after
simulador.nota: Compares the capacity-based schedule with and without the hypothetical absence. Nothing is saved and no absence is registered.
simulador.vazio: Enter the person and the period and click Simulate.
cardpage.aviso.SIMULACAO_SEM_PARAMETROS: Enter the person and the period to simulate.
competencias.pergunta: Who has each skill and which ones depend on a single person or on nobody?
competencias.kpi.semNinguem: Tasks asking for a skill nobody has
competencias.nota: Skills come from equipes.yaml, only for the people in your view. "Single person" only appears with 2 or more people in view.
revisoes.pergunta: How many reviews does each reviewer have pending, how many are overdue and how many passed the review deadline?
revisoes.nota: Review deadline in business days since creation (slaRevisaoDias, in planejamento.yaml). Reviewers in alphabetical order, no ranking.
cargaTipo.pergunta: How much open and closed work is there per task type and OS version?
cargaTipo.abertas: Open by type and OS (tasks and queue hours)
cargaTipo.fechadas: Closed by type and OS (tasks and effort)
cargaTipo.nota: No OS is its own column. Types and versions in alphabetical order.
cardpage.aviso.SEM_VAZAO_HISTORICA: No deliveries in the last weeks: without throughput there is no way to estimate when the backlog ends.
cardpage.aviso.EPICO_INDISPONIVEL: No task with an epic: the epic field (Epic Link) has not been synced yet or is not used.
negativas.pergunta: What went off track in the period: reopened, sent back, cancelled or delivered late?
Late tasks with no label that justifies the delay.
negativas.taxa.semConcluidas: No completed tasks in the period
negativas.porPessoa.nota: Alphabetical order, no ranking. Each event goes to whoever was the assignee at that moment.
negativas.porPessoa.vazio: No negative event attributed to the people in your scope.
riscos.pergunta: Which open tasks are most at risk of being late or stuck, and why?
riscos.kpi.medio.dica: From {n} points up to the high limit
riscos.lista.vazia: No task at high or medium risk.
riscos.fatores.limitado: The sum of the factors is {soma}; the total is capped at 100.
riscos.porPessoa.nota: Alphabetical order, no ranking. It is a proportion of signals over open tasks, not an assessment of the person.
riscos.porPessoa.vazio: No open task assigned to the people in your scope.
riscos.rodape: Rules: {versao}. The weights are heuristic (risco.yaml) and will be calibrated with real history.
previsao.pergunta: When does the backlog finish and how much fits in the next weeks, by the real delivery and arrival pace?
previsao.semChegada: The arrival rate was not part of the calculation (previsao.yaml): only throughput counts, as in the previous app.
previsao.quantos: How many items in 2, 4 and 8 weeks
previsao.quantos.nota: A projection with no tasks behind it. P85 and P95 are conservative: 85% and 95% of the draws did at least that.
previsao.porTask.nota: In-progress tasks only: what is left, by the cycles of the same type that went past the task's age. With fewer than 5 longer cycles, a dash. "By capacity" is the finish forecast from the assignee's capacity queue and "Late?" compares it with the due date.
previsao.porTask.vazia: No in-progress task in your scope.
previsao.rodape: Rules: {versao}. Monte Carlo with the seed of the day and filters: reloading on the same day shows the same number.
epicos.pergunta: How are the epics doing: how much has been delivered, what is overdue and when does it finish?
epicos.legenda: Items without review types and without cancelled tasks. A dash in the forecast: fewer than {n} deliveries of the epic itself in the history (the team's throughput is never used).
card.cr01.oQueMostra: The checklists that have a review linked to them through the blocking link, one pair per row. The card opens the checklists of the pairs.
card.cr01.comoCalcula: Each pair is the "Blocks / is blocked by" link between a checklist (the parent types in checklist_review.yaml) and a Checklist Review, in both directions; the parent field does not define the pair. The filter applies to the checklist, and you see the pairs you take part in (parent or review). Period by the parent's resolution; open ones are always in.
card.cr02.oQueMostra: Checklists that have no review linked through the blocking link. The card opens those checklists.
card.cr02.comoCalcula: Count of checklists of the parent types, within the filter, with no resolved link to a Checklist Review. Same filters and the same view as the parent.
card.cr03.oQueMostra: How long a review takes from its first move into progress until resolution, as a median. The card opens the pairs with a completed review.
card.cr03.comoCalcula: Median (P50) cycle of the reviews completed with a positive resolution, in business (or calendar) days, from the active start to the resolution. Only reviews of the visible pairs.
card.cr04.oQueMostra: What share of the checklist cycle the review takes up, as a median. The card opens the pairs with a completed review.
card.cr04.comoCalcula: Median of the ratio review cycle ÷ checklist cycle, in pairs with a completed review and a checklist cycle greater than zero.
card.cr05.oQueMostra: How many hours after the checklist the review is created, as a median. The card opens the pairs.
card.cr05.comoCalcula: Median of (review creation − checklist creation), in calendar hours, over all visible pairs.
card.cr06.oQueMostra: Pairs where the review's due date is later than the checklist's: the review deadline does not fit the parent's. The card opens those pairs.
card.cr06.comoCalcula: Pairs with both due dates filled in and the review due after the checklist due date, ÷ all pairs. Attention above the limit in checklist_review.yaml.
card.cr07.oQueMostra: Pairs where the checklist and the review have the same assignee: there is no independent review. The card opens those pairs.
card.cr07.comoCalcula: Pairs with the same current assignee on the checklist and on the review ÷ all pairs. Attention above the limit in checklist_review.yaml. It is a count of pairs, not a list of people.
card.cr08.oQueMostra: Pairs with at least one of the six alerts (review due later, parent closed first, same person, short review with reopened parent, overdue review, late review). The card opens the pairs and each alert opens its own.
card.cr08.comoCalcula: Pairs with any alert ÷ all pairs. Problem above the limit in checklist_review.yaml. A hint of a weak review, not proof.
card.cr10.oQueMostra: Sentences the panel only writes when the sample allows: review duration × parent reopening, labels with more reopening and pair patterns.
card.cr10.comoCalcula: Each sentence requires the minimum sample from checklist_review.yaml (a band or label with enough n; pair sentences with enough pairs). Below that no sentence is generated.
card.cr11.oQueMostra: For each band of the review's active hours, how many pairs there are and in how many the checklist was reopened. Each band opens its pairs.
card.cr11.comoCalcula: Completed reviews, grouped by the calendar hours spent in an active status (cut-offs from checklist_review.yaml, lower bound inclusive), and the share of parents that left a done status at some point. A band with low n is marked.
card.cr12.oQueMostra: Pairs where the review finished after the checklist's due date, pushing back the parent's closing. It is a count of pairs, with no names. The card opens those pairs.
card.cr12.comoCalcula: Pairs with a checklist due date and a review resolved on a Manaus day after it. A review still open is left out (it shows as "overdue review").
card.cr13.oQueMostra: For each label, in how many pairs it appears, in how many the checklist was reopened and the lift against the average. Each label opens its pairs.
card.cr13.comoCalcula: Lift = reopening rate of the pairs with the label ÷ the average rate of all pairs. The checklist's label and the review's count once per pair; "review" is a technical tag and is left out. Below the minimum sample the lift is marked as low n.
card.cr14.oQueMostra: Labels that exist only on the checklist or only on the review, with the number of pairs. Each row opens the pairs.
card.cr14.comoCalcula: Per pair, checklist labels the review lacks and review labels the checklist lacks (without the technical "review" tag); the 14 most common.
cardpage.aviso.PARES_EM_AMOSTRA_PEQUENA: Few pairs ({n} of at least {minimo}): the numbers are unstable and no learning sentence is written.
cardpage.aviso.LISTA_PARCIAL: The table shows {n} of {total} pairs; the numbers and the drawer include all of them.
cardpage.aviso.VINCULO_AMBIGUO: {n} checklist-to-review link(s) are ambiguous: the pair with the lowest key was kept.
cardpage.aviso.VINCULOS_INDISPONIVEIS: No link of the configured type in the database: the pairs appear once the sync brings the links.
cr.pergunta: Was each checklist's review done on time, by someone else and with a plausible duration?
cr.regras: Rules {versao}. Learnings and lift only with n of at least {n}. A hint of a weak review, not proof.
cr.kpi.semReview.dica: No blocking link to a review
cr.kpi.cadeia.dica: Review finished after the parent's deadline
cr.col.label: Label
cr.alerta.MESMA_PESSOA: Same person on the checklist and the review
cr.faixas.nota: Completed reviews only. Bands with low n show the number, with no sentence.
cr.labels.nota: Lift = reopening of the pairs with the label ÷ average. With n below {n} the lift is marked as low n.
cr.labels.vazio: No labels in the pairs of the period.
cr.dif.vazio: No label differences between checklist and review.
cr.aprendizados.vazio: Not enough sample to write a learning (minimum of {n}).
cr.aprendizados.nota: Hints about the process, never about people.
cr.aprendizado.REVIEW_CURTA_REABRE_MAIS: With a short review, the checklist was reopened in {curta}% of cases, against {longa}% when the review is long.
cr.aprendizado.MESMA_PESSOA_SEM_REVISAO_: {n} pairs ({pct}%) have the same person on the checklist and the review: there is no independent review.
cr.aprendizado.REVIEW_VENCE_DEPOIS_DO_PA: {n} reviews ({pct}%) are due after the checklist: the review deadline does not fit the parent's.
cr.aprendizado.PAI_FECHADO_ANTES_DA_REVI: {n} checklists ({pct}%) were closed before the review finished.
cr.aprendizado.LABEL_REABRE_MAIS: The label {label} is associated with more checklist reopening ({lift}× the average, in {n} pairs).
cr.pares.vazio: No pairs in the period and filters.
cr.pares.nota: The pair is the blocking link, never the parent field. An assignee only shows when in your view.
cr.semReview.vazio: Every checklist in the filter has a review.

card.in01.oQueMostra: Hints of possible manipulation of deadlines or flow found in the period, one per signal and task. A hint, not proof. The card opens the tasks.
card.in01.comoCalcula: Each piece of evidence is one of the 12 signals triggered by a changelog event inside the period, computed at query time (nothing is stored). The person of the signal is the author of that event. Only the manager sees it, and every query is logged.
card.in02.titulo: People with a high or medium hint
card.in02.oQueMostra: How many people are at each hint level and their evidence; the card opens the evidence of those people. Alphabetical, no ranking. A level is a reason to talk, not a grade.
card.in02.comoCalcula: Rate = points ÷ max(completed, minimum); multiple = rate ÷ median of the rates (with a floor). High: points, multiple and serious signals above the thresholds; medium: points and multiple. Thresholds in integridade.yaml, not calibrated yet.
card.in03.oQueMostra: How many tasks have at least one piece of evidence in the selection. The card opens those tasks.
card.in03.comoCalcula: Count of distinct tasks among the evidence of the selection (period, squad, signal and person).
card.in04.oQueMostra: The median rate of points per completed task in the team; it is the basis of each person's multiple. No tasks behind it.
card.in04.comoCalcula: Median of the rates (points ÷ max(completed, minimum)) of the people with completed tasks in the period, with the floor from integridade.yaml.
card.in05.oQueMostra: How much evidence each of the 12 signals had in the selection, in catalog order. Each signal opens its tasks.
card.in05.comoCalcula: Count of the evidence of each active signal, with the severity (1 to 3) from integridade.yaml. A switched-off signal stays at zero and is marked inactive.
card.in06.oQueMostra: By how many percentage points the current "on time" is above "on time by the original date" in the same period; a hint that extensions improve the goal. No tasks behind it.
card.in06.comoCalcula: (on-time rate − rate by the original date) × 100, from the Goals and deadlines screen for the same period and squad; empty if either rate does not exist.
card.in07.oQueMostra: Each piece of evidence with the task, the signal, the severity, the person of the signal and the day. The card opens the tasks.
card.in07.comoCalcula: The same evidence as the evidence card, one per row, in natural task-key order (never by person or severity).
card.in08.oQueMostra: What each signal looks for, its severity and configured limit, with no data about people. No tasks behind it.
card.in08.comoCalcula: Read from the versioned integridade.yaml: severity, whether it is active and the thresholds (hours, minutes, share of life, labels).
cardpage.aviso.SINAL_SEM_DADO: The signal {sinal} is on, but the changelog does not store the estimate value yet: no evidence is possible.
cardpage.aviso.EVIDENCIAS_PARCIAIS: The table shows {n} of {total} pieces of evidence; the numbers and the drawer include all of them.
integridade.pergunta: Are there signs that deadlines or flow were adjusted suspiciously? Each signal is a reason to talk and check in Jira.
integridade.aviso.indicio: A hint, not proof. Each signal calls for human review, with the person and the context (for example, an extension authorized by the customer). Do not use it as a performance grade.
integridade.aviso.dpo: Validate the legal basis with the DPO before real use. Until then, fixtures and demonstration data only.
integridade.semPermissao: This screen is for the manager only. Your role does not allow you to see this data.
integridade.aguardandoDpo: This screen stays off until the data protection officer (DPO) approves its use. No data was queried.
integridade.filtroInvalido: A filter is invalid (the period goes up to 180 days).
integridade.erro: Could not load the integrity data.
integridade.regras: Rules {versao}. Period of up to 180 days; levels use the whole period and squad, and the signal and person filters only narrow the list.
integridade.kpi.pessoas.dica: {n} piece(s) of evidence of these people
integridade.kpi.impacto.dica: On time minus by the original date
integridade.kpi.impacto.sem: Missing one of the two rates in the period
integridade.tabela.pessoas: People with a high or medium hint
integridade.alfabetica: Alphabetical order, no ranking. A level is a reason to talk, not a grade.
integridade.nivel.regra: High: at least {pontosAlto} points, {multiploAlto}× the median and {gravesAlto} serious signals. Medium: at least {pontosMedio} points and {multiploMedio}× the median. Rate = points ÷ max(completed, {concluidasMinimas}).
integridade.semPessoas: Nobody with a high or medium hint in the selection.
integridade.sinal.RESGATE_POR_PRORROGACA: Late delivery rescued by an extension
integridade.sinal.LABEL_CRITICIDADE_REMO: Criticality label removed near the end
integridade.sinal.FECHADA_POR_OUTRO: Closed by someone who was not the assignee
integridade.regra.RESGATE_POR_PRORROGACA: The due date was extended after it passed and the task was delivered after the old deadline but by the new one.
integridade.regra.TROCA_ANTES_DE_FECHAR: Someone took over the task up to {horas} h before closing it and was the one who closed it.
integridade.regra.CRIADA_E_FECHADA_RAPID: The task was closed less than {minutos} min after being created.
integridade.regra.REABRE_E_FECHA_RAPIDO: Closed, reopened and closed again, each step in under {horas} h (renews the resolution date).
integridade.regra.FECHAMENTO_EM_LOTE: {quantidade} tasks or more closed by the same person within {minutos} min.
integridade.regra.VENCIMENTO_PRORROGADO: The due date was moved later (not added to the rescue on the same event).
integridade.regra.VENCIMENTO_TARDIO: The first due date was only filled in after {pct}% of the task's life.
integridade.regra.PULOU_O_FLUXO: The task reached done without ever going through a working status (active category).
integridade.regra.ESTIMATIVA_AUMENTADA: The original estimate rose {pct}% or more. Needs the value in the changelog, which is not stored yet.
integridade.regra.LABEL_CRITICIDADE_REMO: A criticality label ({labels}) was removed up to {dias} day(s) before closing.
integridade.regra.FECHADA_POR_OUTRO: Whoever completed the task was not the assignee at the time.
integridade.regra.FECHADA_NO_LIMITE: Closed on the due date, from {hora}:00 Manaus time (a weak signal, it only weighs in volume).

card.di01.oQueMostra: The "to do" tasks with no assignee or assigned to the manager, waiting for someone to take them. The card opens those tasks.
card.di01.comoCalcula: Open tasks in the "to do" category whose assignee is empty or has the manager role today. A squad leader only counts the ones within their own view.
card.di02.oQueMostra: The pending tasks for which the dashboard suggests a person and that nobody approved, swapped or rejected today. The card opens those tasks.
card.di02.comoCalcula: Pending tasks with a suggested person whose suggestion of the day has no recorded decision yet. The suggestion lives only in the dashboard (shadow mode): nothing changes in Jira.
card.di03.oQueMostra: The Jain index of the load of the eligible people before and after applying every suggestion (1.0 = everyone equal). It is an index of the group, never a score for a person.
card.di03.comoCalcula: Jain = (sum of loads)² ÷ (n × sum of squares), each load (workload ÷ 4-week capacity) capped at the planning ceiling. It needs two or more eligible people.
card.di04.oQueMostra: The score factors of every candidate for a task, in alphabetical order and without a position: workload, WIP, missing skills and experience on the epic.
card.di04.comoCalcula: Score = projected workload × productivity ÷ capacity + WIP weight × WIP ÷ limit + penalty when WIP is full + weight × missing skills − epic or component bonus; the lowest wins. Weights live in distribuicao.yaml.
card.rb01.oQueMostra: The tasks not started yet that the dashboard suggests taking from whoever is above the load trigger, each with the suggested destination. The card opens those tasks.
card.rb01.comoCalcula: Whoever has a 4-week load above the trigger gives up not-started tasks to someone with the skill who ends up at least 20 percentage points below the origin after the move, in up to 10 moves.
card.rb02.oQueMostra: The suggested moves that nobody approved, swapped or rejected today. The card opens those tasks.
card.rb02.comoCalcula: Suggested moves whose suggestion of the day has no decision recorded in the dashboard yet. Nothing is written to Jira.
card.dc01.oQueMostra: The decisions to approve, swap or reject suggestions, newest first, with who decided and why. There is no count and no ordering by person.
card.dc01.comoCalcula: Reads the dashboard's decisions table for the chosen period (up to 366 days). Nothing comes from Jira and nothing goes to it.
distribuicao.pergunta: Who should take each task that is waiting for an owner?
distribuicao.sombra: Shadow mode: nothing is changed in Jira
distribuicao.sombra.detalhe: The dashboard only suggests and keeps your decision here; nobody changes assignee because of this screen.
distribuicao.kpi.jain.nota: Jain index of the group (1.0 = everyone equal); never a score for a person.
distribuicao.kpi.jain.indisponivel: Needs two or more people with capacity.
distribuicao.vazia: No task is waiting for an owner in your view.
distribuicao.nota: Each person's factors are in alphabetical order: the dashboard shows why it suggests someone, not a ranking of people.
distribuicao.rodape: Rules: {versao}. Suggestions are recalculated on every request.
distribuicao.semSugestao: Nobody has capacity available for this task.
decisao.motivo.dica: Explain the swap in up to {n} characters.
decisao.erro.mudou: The suggestion changed. The screen was reloaded.
decisao.erro.semPermissao: You cannot decide about this task or this person.
decisao.erro.geral: The decision could not be saved. Try again.
rebalanceamento.pergunta: What can be moved away from whoever is above capacity?
rebalanceamento.regra: Trigger: load above {gatilho}% over 4 weeks. The destination ends at least {pp} percentage points below the origin after the move. Only tasks not started yet are considered.
rebalanceamento.vazia: Nobody is above the trigger, or no not-started task fits someone else.
decisoes.pergunta: What was decided about the distribution and rebalancing suggestions?
decisoes.nota: From {de} to {ate}, newest first. No count and no ordering by person.
decisoes.vazia: No decision recorded in the period.
decisoes.truncado: The list was cut at the most recent decisions; choose a shorter period to see earlier ones.
card.qd01.oQueMostra: How many open tasks have no estimate, assignee, due date or epic, are in progress without logged hours, have an assignee missing from papeis.yaml or still carry the default priority. Each row opens the tasks.
card.qd01.comoCalcula: Each row is n out of a universe: open tasks with a mapped status (in progress without hours counts only tasks in progress; no squad counts only tasks with an assignee). Green up to 10%, orange up to 30%, red above.
card.qd02.oQueMostra: The tasks completed or resolved in the last 90 days where the done status and the resolution disagree. Each row opens the tasks.
card.qd02.comoCalcula: Status in the done category without a resolution, and a filled resolution with a status that is not done, among the tasks completed or resolved in 90 days.
card.qd03.oQueMostra: Statuses missing from status_map.yaml and recent labels that are neither in labels_atraso.yaml nor in the ignored list. The manager fixes them in the YAML files; the dashboard only reads.
card.qd03.comoCalcula: Statuses: tasks whose status is not in the map. Labels: tasks with a label that neither justifies a delay nor is ignored (informative, case-insensitive).
card.qd04.oQueMostra: The tasks in a blocked status or with the impediment flag that have no open link explaining it. The card opens those tasks.
card.qd04.comoCalcula: The same count as the Blocking card: blocked status category or flag, with no open blocking link and no endpoint outside the database.
card.qd05.oQueMostra: The Jira fields still to be confirmed (Story Points, Epic Link, Flagged, OS Version) where no synchronized issue has a value. It is a list of names, with no tasks.
card.qd05.comoCalcula: A field counts when no issue in the database has a value in it; without the field, the checks that depend on it become unavailable.
qualidade.pergunta: What is missing or mismatched in the data coming from Jira?
qualidade.regra: Each row is n out of a universe. Green up to 10%, orange up to 30%, red above. Completion and labels look at the last {dias} days. The dashboard only reads: the team fixes things in Jira, and the vocabulary belongs to the manager, in the YAML files.
qualidade.verif.CAMPO_INDISPONIVEL: Field with no value in any issue
qualidade.labels.dica: To classify one, the manager adds the label to justificativas or ignoradas in labels_atraso.yaml. The list is in alphabetical order.
card.ra01.oQueMostra: Who queried which dashboard route and when, with the result (200, 400, 403) and only the names of the filters used. It shows no task key, segment or filter value.
card.ra01.comoCalcula: Reads the log the dashboard itself writes on every query, including denied ones and the query to this screen. Newest first, in pages of 200, up to 90 days. No count and no ordering by person.
card.cf01.oQueMostra: The environment mode, the synchronization mode and, for each rules file, the version, the hash and whether the real file or the template applies. Read-only.
card.cf01.comoCalcula: Reads the configuration folder: the hash is the SHA-256 of the content. It never shows secrets, URLs, paths, people's names or the content of roles, teams and absences; for those only the counts.
acessos.pergunta: Who queried what on the dashboard, and when?
acessos.nota: From {de} to {ate}, newest first. No count and no ordering by person; the task key and the filter values are not stored.
acessos.vazia: No query recorded in the period.
configuracao.pergunta: Which rules and which mode is the dashboard running with?
configuracao.nota: Read-only: the manager edits the YAML files. Roles, teams and absences do not appear here, only the counts.
card.vg01.oQueMostra: How many tasks are open (not done) in the viewer's scope. It opens the same tasks as the Open tasks card.
card.vg01.comoCalcula: It is the open count of the Open tasks card: tasks in a status that is not done, within the role's scope.
card.vg04.titulo: On time and adjusted on time
card.vg04.oQueMostra: Of the tasks due in the last 90 days, how many finished on time and how many on adjusted time (with a justified delay). Both metrics sit side by side.
card.vg04.comoCalcula: They are the numbers of the Goals and due dates card, with the same rule and the same 90-day period. The universe is the total of tasks due in the period.
card.vg05.oQueMostra: Open tasks whose due date has passed. It opens the same tasks as the Neglected card.
card.vg05.comoCalcula: It is the overdue count of the Neglected card: open tasks with a due date before today (Manaus day).
card.vg08.oQueMostra: How many open tasks are at high risk and at medium risk by the explainable score. It opens the same tasks as the Risks card.
card.vg08.comoCalcula: They are the numbers of the Risks card, with the limits of risco.yaml: high from 60 points and medium from 30 to 59, by default.
card.vg09.oQueMostra: The indicators that call for the attention of the coordination and the manager: overdue, risk, capacity, predicted delays, no update, stuck, no assignee, blocked, goals, checklist and review, divergence, changes without authorization and estimate. Each indicator opens its tasks.
card.vg09.comoCalcula: Each number is the one of the indicator's target card, with no other calculation: the drawer total is the same. No update and stuck in status are separate indicators, and a task can be in both.
card.vg10.oQueMostra: The tasks completed in each of the last 12 weeks. Each column opens the tasks delivered in the week.
card.vg10.comoCalcula: It is the per-week number of the Closed tasks card, by resolution date (Manaus day), Monday to Sunday.
card.vg11.oQueMostra: The backlog size and the date it should end at the recent pace, at three confidence levels (P50, P85 and P95). It opens the backlog tasks.
card.vg11.comoCalcula: Monte Carlo of the Forecast card over the closed weeks, with no new items beyond the historical arrival. Confidence is low with few weeks of data.
card.vg12.oQueMostra: The average occupancy and the Jain index of each squad over the next 4 weeks. It is an indicator of the group, with no grade for a person.
card.vg12.comoCalcula: Average occupancy (4-week demand divided by capacity) of the squad members who have capacity. Green up to 85%, orange up to 110%, red above.
card.vg13.oQueMostra: The integrity evidence of people with a high indication. It is an indication to check, never proof. Only the manager sees it, and only with the DPO lock open.
card.vg13.comoCalcula: It is the number of the high indication card of Integrity; the query is recorded in the access log.
dpo.telaAguardando: This screen stays off until the data protection officer (DPO) approves its use. No data was queried.
cardpage.aviso.ITENS_AGUARDANDO_ACEITE_D: Some items are left out of this list until the data protection officer (DPO) approves the Audit and Integrity screens.
cardpage.aviso.HISTORICO_AGUARDANDO_ACEI: The change history is left out until the data protection officer (DPO) approves its use.
card.vg14.oQueMostra: The unauthorized changes and Task × Review divergences that the Central highlights. They are indications to check, never proof. They only show with the DPO lock open.
card.vg14.comoCalcula: They are the numbers of the Audit and Divergence cards; the query is recorded in the access log without keeping the finding.
card.mp01.oQueMostra: How many open tasks are with you and how many of them are due in the next 7 days. Each number opens your tasks.
card.mp01.comoCalcula: They are the numbers of the Load per person (queue) and Due this week (7 days) cards for you. A Squad Leader sees the panel of a person in their own squad.
card.mp02.oQueMostra: How much of your capacity over the next 4 weeks your queue takes, after absences and holidays.
card.mp02.comoCalcula: Hours in your queue divided by your net capacity over 4 weeks. Green up to 85%, orange up to 110%, red above. It is a planning indicator, not a grade.
card.mp03.oQueMostra: How many of your open tasks are at medium or high risk by the explainable score. It opens those tasks.
card.mp03.comoCalcula: It is the at-risk task count of the Risks card for you, with the limits of risco.yaml (from 30 points).
card.mp04.oQueMostra: The absence periods registered for you from today on. The dashboard neither stores nor shows the reason.
card.mp04.comoCalcula: Reads the absences in ausencias.yaml that end today or later. Read-only: the manager edits it.
card.mp05.oQueMostra: Your open tasks in the order the schedule would run them, with the finish date predicted by your capacity and a warning when they pass the due date.
card.mp05.comoCalcula: Started ones first; then priority, due date and creation. The finish consumes your net capacity day by day, with absences and holidays.
